description: This file is a shell script used as a DHCP script for dnsmasq in OpenWrt. It processes DHCP and ARP events, constructs JSON messages, and triggers corresponding ubus calls to handle network event hotplug actions.

methods.name: json_add_array
methods.description: Adds a JSON array to the current JSON object.

methods.name: json_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to the JSON object.

methods.name: json_dump
methods.description: Serializes the JSON object into a string.
